recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-31545 source work is needed unless OO later chooses to refine the broader NutritionProduct, Medication, or administration boundary in a new tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-31545 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification R6 OO change request asking how NutritionProduct should be differentiated from AdministrableProductDefinition and how it might be administered. The approved resolution required adding AdministrableProductDefinition to NutritionProduct Boundaries and Relationships with wording that it describes regulated medicinal products, including parenteral nutrition, intended for administration as a drug or infusion.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied upstream in commit f08af008345a71485a7eee5f3ce559a3c12559dd, which added the AdministrableProductDefinition boundary bullet to source/nutritionproduct/nutritionproduct-introduction.xml as part of a broader Nutrition update for FHIR-31545, FHIR-50383, FHIR-52017, and FHIR-50314.
additional_context: NutritionProduct and AdministrableProductDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The combined branch already contains the upstream source application and no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-31545. OO HCP minutes from 2025-09-29 record the same FHIR-31545 motion and wording with a 6-0-0 vote. Related issues from the same upstream patch are already represented on the combined branch and were not republished here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already links to AdministrableProductDefinition in NutritionProduct Boundaries and Relationships and uses wording equivalent to the approved Jira resolution.
